composition:
  authorize: "hasRole('OWNER_ADMIN')"

# Validate required fields first, so a missing/blank field is a 400 listing every
# offending field before the body is mapped to an entity.
validate:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.ValidateOwnerFields
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: validatePostcode

# Reject with 400 when a supplied postcode is malformed (not 4 digits) or out of range for the
# city's region. Absent postcode is accepted (optional). Runs after the required-field validation,
# so the city is known before its region range is applied.
validatePostcode:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.ValidatePostcode
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: checkCityCapacity

# Reject with 409 when the owner's city already contains 50 or more owners.
checkCityCapacity:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.CheckOwnerCityCapacity
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: checkDailyCreateLimit

# Reject with 429 when 100 or more owners have already been created today (by registrationDate).
checkDailyCreateLimit:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.CheckOwnerDailyCreateLimit
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: build

build:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.BuildOwner
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: assignHousehold

# Assign the deterministic 'householdId' (first 12 hex of SHA-256 over lastName + '|' + postcode),
# so owners with the same last name and postcode share it automatically.
assignHousehold:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignHouseholdId
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: checkHousehold

# Household-duplicate block: reject with 409 when the new owner's computed householdId already
# belongs to an existing owner, UNLESS the body declared 'sharesHousehold' (a declared household
# member bypasses this block). Runs after the householdId is assigned and before the identity check.
checkHousehold:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.CheckHouseholdUnique
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: checkIdentity

# Consolidated duplicate check: reject with 409 when the new owner's whole identityKey
# (normalizedTelephone|email|householdId) equals an existing owner's. Runs after the householdId
# has been assigned/back-filled (so it is part of the key) and before save (so the not-yet-saved
# owner is not compared against itself).
checkIdentity:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.CheckOwnerIdentityUnique
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: assignHouseholdMemberCount

# Count the owners in this owner's household (sharing 'householdId'), including this
# not-yet-saved owner. Runs after the shared householdId has been assigned and back-filled.
assignHouseholdMemberCount:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignHouseholdMemberCount
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: assignNamesakeCount

# Record how many existing owners share this owner's firstName and lastName
# (case-insensitively), before it is saved so the count excludes it.
assignNamesakeCount:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignNamesakeCount
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: assignCode

# Assign the '<REGION>-<HASH8>' customer code before saving: REGION from the postcode and
# HASH8 = SHA-256(normalizedTelephone + lastName)[0:8] upper hex. A stable per-owner identity,
# so this no longer depends on the count of existing owners.
assignCode:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignCustomerCode
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: assignBulkSignupWarning

# Set 'bulkSignupWarning' true when more than 80 owners were already created today (by the
# adjusted business-day registrationDate), before saving so the count excludes this owner.
assignBulkSignupWarning:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignBulkSignupWarning
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: assignPossibleDuplicate

# Soft-match: when the new owner is not a hard (identityKey) duplicate but shares an existing
# owner's lastName and postcode with a different telephone, still create it and set
# 'possibleDuplicate' true with 'possibleDuplicateOf' the matching owner id; otherwise false.
# Runs after the identity check (so hard duplicates never reach here) and before save.
assignPossibleDuplicate:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignPossibleDuplicate
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: save

save:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.SaveOwner
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: audit

# Emit an AUDIT log line carrying the owner id, customerCode and registrationDate,
# after save so the generated id is available.
audit:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AuditOwnerCreated
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: respond

respond:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.RespondWithOwnerCreated
  govern: [ transaction ]

content.text: Spring Boot 4.1.0 + the `-4-starter`, and no `@RestController` exists — so this YAML pipeline genuinely handles `POST /api/owners`. Let me read each step class in order.

Here is the complete ordered pipeline for `POST /api/owners` (`owners.POST.yml`). Every step runs under `govern: [ transaction ]`, so the whole request commits once at the end. Validations reject before any write; side-effects mutate the owner in place and are read by later steps.

## Gate (before any step)
- **Authorization** — the file's `composition.authorize: "hasRole('OWNER_ADMIN')"` requires the caller to hold `OWNER_ADMIN`; otherwise the pipeline never runs.

## 1. `ValidateOwnerFields` (reads the `@RequestBody` — the only step that does)
Validations:
- **Required fields** — `firstName`, `lastName`, `city`, `telephone` must be non-null and non-blank; `address` must be non-blank *after normalization*. All offending fields are collected and returned together → **400** (`OwnerFieldsInvalidException`).
- **registrationDate not in the future** — a supplied date later than `LocalDate.now()` → 400. Absent is allowed.
- **Telephone must form valid E.164** — normalized via `E164Telephone`; `null` result → 400.
- **Email (optional) syntactic check** — must match the email regex → 400 if present-and-malformed.
- **Email disposable-domain block** — `mailinator.com`, `tempmail.com`, `guerrillamail.com` → 400. *(Not mentioned in the YAML comments.)*

Side-effects (written back onto the DTO body, published for later steps):
- Address normalized (trim, collapse whitespace, upper-case, expand `ST`/`RD`/`AVE`) and stored back.
- Telephone rewritten to E.164 form.
- Email trimmed + lower-cased and stored back (only when present).

## 2. `ValidatePostcode`
- If postcode **absent/blank** → accepted, no change.
- If present: must be **exactly 4 digits** → else 400.
- If the city maps to a known region (`Sydney→NSW`, `Melbourne→VIC`, `Brisbane→QLD`), postcode must fall in that region's inclusive range (NSW 2000–2099, VIC 3000–3099, QLD 4000–4099) → else 400. Unknown city accepts any 4-digit value.

## 3. `CheckOwnerCityCapacity`
- Rejects with **409** if the owner's city (case-insensitive) already contains **≥ 50** owners.

## 4. `CheckOwnerDailyCreateLimit`
- Rejects with **429** if **≥ 100** owners already have a `registrationDate` equal to today's business day (today rolled forward off weekends via `BusinessDays.rollForward`).

## 5. `BuildOwner` (side-effects — DTO → `Owner` entity)
- Maps the DTO to an `Owner` via `OwnerMapper`.
- Defaults `registrationDate` to `LocalDate.now()` when none supplied.
- Rolls `registrationDate` forward off weekends to the next business day.

## 6. `AssignHouseholdId` (side-effect)
- Sets `householdId` = first 12 hex of `SHA-256(normalizedLastName + "|" + postcode)` (lower-case/trimmed/whitespace-collapsed last name; absent postcode → empty string). Deterministic — shared by same last name + postcode.

## 7. `CheckHouseholdUnique`
- Rejects with **409** if the computed `householdId` already belongs to an existing owner — **unless** the request declared `sharesHousehold: true`, which bypasses this block only.

## 8. `CheckOwnerIdentityUnique`
- Rejects with **409** if the owner's full `identityKey` = `normalizedTelephone|email|householdId` (from `OwnerIdentityKey`) exactly matches an existing owner's. (Same household with a different phone → different key → allowed.)

## 9. `AssignHouseholdMemberCount` (side-effect)
- Sets `householdMemberCount` = existing owners sharing the `householdId` **+ 1** (the new, not-yet-saved owner).

## 10. `AssignNamesakeCount` (side-effect)
- Sets `namesakeCount` = count of existing owners sharing this owner's `firstName` + `lastName` (case-insensitive), excluding the new one.

## 11. `AssignCustomerCode` (side-effect)
- Sets `customerCode` = `<REGION>-<HASH8>`, where REGION comes from the postcode (`OwnerRegion`) and HASH8 = first 8 upper-hex chars of `SHA-256(normalizedTelephone + lastName)`. Does not read the repository.

## 12. `AssignBulkSignupWarning` (side-effect)
- Sets `bulkSignupWarning = true` when **> 80** owners were already created on today's business day, else `false`.

## 13. `AssignPossibleDuplicate` (side-effect)
- Soft-match: sets `possibleDuplicate = true` and `possibleDuplicateOf =` the lowest-id matching owner when an existing owner shares this owner's `lastName` (case-insensitive) + exact `postcode` but has a **different** normalized telephone and a **different** `householdId`. Otherwise `possibleDuplicate = false` and `possibleDuplicateOf` left absent. (Hard duplicates already rejected in step 8; same-household members are skipped.)

## 14. `SaveOwner` (side-effect)
- Persists the owner via `ownerRepository.save(owner)` — generates the id.

## 15. `AuditOwnerCreated` (side-effect)
- Logs an `AUDIT` line: owner `id`, `customerCode`, `registrationDate`, and `membershipLevel` (from `OwnerMapper.membershipLevel`). Runs after save so the id exists.

## 16. `RespondWithOwnerCreated` (side-effect — response)
- Maps to `OwnerDto` and sends **201 Created** with `Location: /api/owners/{id}` and the DTO body.

---

Two things worth flagging since they aren't obvious from the YAML comments: **ValidateOwnerFields also rejects disposable email domains** (step 1), and the ordering choice means a **malformed body (400) is reported before capacity/limit conflicts (409/429)** — but note capacity/daily-limit checks (steps 3–4) run *before* duplicate checks, so a request could get a 429 even though it would also have been a 409 duplicate.

- Sets `namesakeCount` = count of existing owners sharing this owner's `firstName` + `lastName` (case-insensitive), excluding the new one.

## 11. `AssignCustomerCode` (side-effect)
- Sets `customerCode` = `<REGION>-<HASH8>`, where REGION comes from the postcode (`OwnerRegion`) and HASH8 = first 8 upper-hex chars of `SHA-256(normalizedTelephone + lastName)`. Does not read the repository.

## 12. `AssignBulkSignupWarning` (side-effect)
- Sets `bulkSignupWarning = true` when **> 80** owners were already created on today's business day, else `false`.

## 13. `AssignPossibleDuplicate` (side-effect)
- Soft-match: sets `possibleDuplicate = true` and `possibleDuplicateOf =` the lowest-id matching owner when an existing owner shares this owner's `lastName` (case-insensitive) + exact `postcode` but has a **different** normalized telephone and a **different** `householdId`. Otherwise `possibleDuplicate = false` and `possibleDuplicateOf` left absent. (Hard duplicates already rejected in step 8; same-household members are skipped.)

## 14. `SaveOwner` (side-effect)
- Persists the owner via `ownerRepository.save(owner)` — generates the id.

## 15. `AuditOwnerCreated` (side-effect)
- Logs an `AUDIT` line: owner `id`, `customerCode`, `registrationDate`, and `membershipLevel` (from `OwnerMapper.membershipLevel`). Runs after save so the id exists.

## 16. `RespondWithOwnerCreated` (side-effect — response)
- Maps to `OwnerDto` and sends **201 Created** with `Location: /api/owners/{id}` and the DTO body.

---

Two things worth flagging since they aren't obvious from the YAML comments: **ValidateOwnerFields also rejects disposable email domains** (step 1), and the ordering choice means a **malformed body (400) is reported before capacity/limit conflicts (409/429)** — but note capacity/daily-limit checks (steps 3–4) run *before* duplicate checks, so a request could get a 429 even though it would also have been a 409 duplicate.
